event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approximately 6.1nm southwest of Pulau Nipa, (Indonesia), Straits of Malacca and Singapore (SOMS) Indonesia

sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2023
sources.text: A search on board was subsequently carried out. At the time of the incident, the ship was transiting the TSS eastbound for China. At about 2327 hrs, the master confirmed that no further sighting of perpetrator onboard. All crew members were safe and accounted for, and nothing was reported stolen. No further assistance was required.
